Hebrish Keyboard ${VER}: HeliBoard [${UPSTREAM}](https://github.com/HeliBorg/HeliBoard/releases/tag/${UPSTREAM}) with Hebrish dictation on the mic key. Engine: ${SUBMODULES} (`Hebrish-ASR/Hebrish-App`).

**Early.** Built and released automatically; please [report problems here](https://github.com/Hebrish-ASR/Hebrish-Keyboard/issues), not to HeliBoard. arm64 phones only. First use of the mic key downloads the model (~660 MB, once).

Installs alongside HeliBoard (application ID `app.hebrish.keyboard`). Signed with the same key as the Hebrish app. Also in the Hebrish F-Droid repository: https://hebrish.app/download#keyboard
